entries.text:
Review is clear. `a2a23db` fixes all three earlier findings: refreshes are serialized, obsolete responses are ignored, and successful refreshes clear errors.

The delayed-response and error-recovery tests cover those fixes. Read-only, in-memory checks of the actual effect also passed. No new actionable defects found in `master..HEAD`.
